title: A New Minimum Variance Spectral Estimation Method for Analyzing Click-Evoked Otoacoustic Emissions
title_en: A New Minimum Variance Spectral Estimation Method for Analyzing Click-Evoked Otoacoustic Emissions
title_zh: 一种用于分析点击诱发耳声发射的新最小方差谱估计方法
abstract_en: This paper proposes a new minimum variance spectral estimation (MVSE)-based time-frequency analysis (TFA) for click-evoked otoacoustic emissions (CEOAEs). The conventional MVSE is extended to TFA by windowing the observation data to obtain a time-frequency distribution for the time-series. Based on the characteristics of CEOAEs, the window size is given a small value at high frequencies and a large value at low frequencies. The adaptive window size yields the proposed frequency-dependent WMVSE (FDWMVSE). The FDWMVSE integrates the advantages of adaptive window selection of wavelet transform and good resolution of MVSE. Experimental results show that the FDWMVSE can achieve better frequency resolution than other TFA methods when applied to synthesized and real CEOAEs
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于最小方差谱估计（MVSE）的时频分析（TFA），用于点击诱发耳声发射（CEOAE）。通过对观测数据加窗以获得时间序列的时频分布，将传统的MVSE扩展到TFA。根据CEOAE的特点，窗口大小在高频时取小值，在低频时取大值。自适应窗口大小产生所提出的频率相关 WMVSE (FDWMVSE)。 FDWMVSE综合了小波变换自适应窗口选择和MVSE分辨率好的优点。实验结果表明，FDWMVSE在应用于场景时能够比其他TFA方法获得更好的频率分辨率。

title: A new adaptive Kalman filter-based subspace tracking algorithm and its application to DOA estimation
title_en: A new adaptive Kalman filter-based subspace tracking algorithm and its application to DOA estimation
title_zh: 一种基于卡尔曼滤波器的自适应子空间跟踪算法及其在DOA估计中的应用
abstract_en: This paper presents a new Kalman filter-based subspace tracking algorithm and its application to directions of arrival (DOA) estimation. An autoregressive (AR) process is used to describe the dynamics of the subspace and a new adaptive Kalman filter with variable measurements (KFVM) algorithm is developed to estimate the time-varying subspace recursively from the state-space model and the given observations. For stationary subspace, the proposed algorithm will switch to the conventional PAST to lower the computational complexity. Simulation results show that the adaptive subspace tracking method has a better performance than conventional algorithms in DOA estimation for a wide variety of experimental condition
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于卡尔曼滤波器的子空间跟踪算法及其在到达方向（DOA）估计中的应用。使用自回归（AR）过程来描述子空间的动态，并开发了一种新的具有变量测量的自适应卡尔曼滤波器（KFVM）算法，以根据状态空间模型和给定的观测值递归地估计时变子空间。对于平稳子空间，所提出的算法将切换到传统的 PAST 以降低计算复杂度。仿真结果表明，在多种实验条件下，自适应子空间跟踪方法在DOA估计方面比传统算法具有更好的性能

title: An Algorithm of Wavelet Network Learning from Noisy Data
title_en: An Algorithm of Wavelet Network Learning from Noisy Data
title_zh: 一种小波网络从噪声数据中学习的算法
venue: World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract_en: Noise often leads to bad generalization of network. Many of the typical algorithms can not be applied for the on-line identification of complex system since they are not robust to the variance of the energy of noise. A new algorithm is proposed to solve this problem based on the frequency band of wavelet network. It is shown that the wavelet network trained by the new algorithm is a low-pass filter, which has removed the noise out the frequency band of network. Since the frequency band of noise is usually higher than that of network, the variance of noise little influences the identification of wavelet network, so the new algorithm is robust to the variance of noise. The analysis of theory and the results of simulation show that the new algorithm has the capacity of avoidance of overfitting and the robustness of noise

title: A new QR-decomposition based recursive frequency estimator for multiple sinusoids in impulsive noise environment
title_en: A new QR-decomposition based recursive frequency estimator for multiple sinusoids in impulsive noise environment
title_zh: 一种新的基于 QR 分解的脉冲噪声环境中多个正弦曲线的递归频率估计器
abstract_en: This paper proposes a new QR-decomposition-based recursive frequency estimation algorithm for multiple sinusoids based on the linear prediction (LP) approach. It extends the batch processing algorithm of So et al. in order to process the input samples recursively at a much lower arithmetic complexity for supporting on-line applications. Furthermore, a weighted least M-estimate (WLM) algorithm is developed to improve robustness to impulsive noise. Simulation results show that the robust recursive frequency estimator has a better performance than the conventional LS estimation in impulsive noise environment
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于 QR 分解的新的基于线性预测 (LP) 方法的多个正弦曲线的递归频率估计算法。它扩展了 So 等人的批处理算法。为了以低得多的算术复杂度递归处理输入样本以支持在线应用程序。此外，还开发了加权最小 M 估计 (WLM) 算法来提高对脉冲噪声的鲁棒性。仿真结果表明鲁棒递归频率估计器在脉冲噪声环境下比传统LS估计具有更好的性能

title: A new Kalman filter-based algorithm for adaptive coherence analysis of non-stationary multichannel time series
title_en: A new Kalman filter-based algorithm for adaptive coherence analysis of non-stationary multichannel time series
title_zh: 一种新的基于卡尔曼滤波器的非平稳多通道时间序列自适应相干分析算法
abstract_en: This paper proposes a new Kalman filter-based algorithm for multichannel autoregressive (AR) spectrum estimation and adaptive coherence analysis with variable number of measurements. A stochastically perturbed k -order difference equation constraint model is used to describe the dynamics of the AR coefficients and the intersection of confidence intervals (ICI) rule is employed to determine the number of measurements adaptively to improve the time-frequency resolution of the AR spectrum and coherence function. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieves a better time-frequency resolution than conventional algorithms for non-stationary signals
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于卡尔曼滤波器的新算法，用于多通道自回归（AR）频谱估计和具有可变测量次数的自适应相干分析。采用随机扰动的k阶差分方程约束模型来描述AR系数的动态，并采用置信区间交集（ICI）规则自适应地确定测量次数，以提高AR频谱和相干函数的时频分辨率。仿真结果表明，该算法对于非平稳信号比传统算法具有更好的时频分辨率

title: A new Kalman filter-based power spectral density estimation for nonstationary pressure signals
title_en: A new Kalman filter-based power spectral density estimation for nonstationary pressure signals
title_zh: 一种新的基于卡尔曼滤波器的非平稳压力信号功率谱密度估计
abstract_en: This paper presents a new Kalman filter-based power spectral density estimation (PSD) algorithm for nonstationary pressure signals. The pressure signal is assumed to be an autoregressive (AR) process, and a stochastically perturbed difference equation constraint model is used to describe the dynamics of the AR coefficients. The proposed Kalman filter frame uses variable number of measurements to estimate the time-varying AR coefficients and yield the PSD estimation with better time-frequency resolution. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieves a better time-frequency resolution than conventional algorithms for nonstationary pressure signals
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于卡尔曼滤波器的非平稳压力信号功率谱密度估计（PSD）算法。假设压力信号是一个自回归（AR）过程，并使用随机扰动差分方程约束模型来描述AR系数的动态。所提出的卡尔曼滤波器框架使用可变数量的测量来估计时变 AR 系数，并产生具有更好时频分辨率的 PSD 估计。仿真结果表明，对于非平稳压力信号，该算法比传统算法具有更好的时频分辨率

title: Robust adaptive channel estimation of OFDM systems in time-varying narrowband interference
title_en: Robust adaptive channel estimation of OFDM systems in time-varying narrowband interference
title_zh: 时变窄带干扰中 OFDM 系统的鲁棒自适应信道估计
abstract_en: The paper presents an adaptive channel estimation algorithm for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems in the presence of narrowband interference (NBI). The performance of the conventional linear minimum mean square error (MMSE) estimator degrades significantly in the presence of the narrowband interference. A new weighted recursive least M-estimate (RLM) algorithm is adopted for suppressing the adverse effect of time-varying narrowband interference to OFDM systems. Simulation results demonstrate the improved robustness of the proposed algorithm.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于存在窄带干扰 (NBI) 的正交频分复用 (OFDM) 系统的自适应信道估计算法。在存在窄带干扰的情况下，传统线性最小均方误差（MMSE）估计器的性能显着下降。采用一种新的加权递归最小M估计(RLM)算法来抑制时变窄带干扰对OFDM系统的不利影响。仿真结果表明所提算法的鲁棒性得到了提高。

title: A new robust Kalman filter algorithm under outliers and system uncertainties
title_en: A new robust Kalman filter algorithm under outliers and system uncertainties
title_zh: 异常值和系统不确定性下的新型鲁棒卡尔曼滤波算法
abstract_en: This paper proposes a new robust Kalman filter algorithm under outliers and system uncertainties. The robust Kalman filter of Durovic and Kovacevic (1999) is extended to include unknown-but-bounded parameter uncertainties in the state or observation matrix. We first formulate the robust state estimation problem as an M-estimation problem, which leads to an unconstrained nonlinear optimization problem. This is then linearized and solved iteratively as a series of linear least-squares problems. These least-squares problems are subject to the bounded system uncertainties using the robust least squares method proposed by A. Ben-Tal and A. Nemirovski (2001). Simulation results show that the new algorithm leads to a better performance than the conventional algorithms under outliers as well as system uncertainties.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的在异常值和系统不确定性下的鲁棒卡尔曼滤波算法。 Durovic 和 Kovacevic (1999) 的鲁棒卡尔曼滤波器被扩展为包括状态或观测矩阵中未知但有界的参数不确定性。我们首先将鲁棒状态估计问题表述为 M 估计问题，这导致了无约束非线性优化问题。然后将其线性化并作为一系列线性最小二乘问题迭代求解。这些最小二乘问题受到使用 A. Ben-Tal 和 A. Nemirovski (2001) 提出的稳健最小二乘法的有界系统不确定性的影响。仿真结果表明，新算法比传统算法有更好的性能...

title: Robust adaptive Lomb periodogram for time-frequency analysis of signals with sinusoidal and transient components
title_en: Robust adaptive Lomb periodogram for time-frequency analysis of signals with sinusoidal and transient components
title_zh: 用于对正弦和瞬态分量信号进行时频分析的鲁棒自适应 Lomb 周期图
abstract_en: This article introduces a robust adaptive Lomb periodogram (RALP) for time-frequency (TF) analysis of a time series with sinusoidal and transient components, which are possibly non-uniformly sampled. It extends the conventional Lomb spectrum by windowing the observation data and adaptively selects the window lengths by the intersection of confidence intervals (ICI) rule. The influence of transient components on the conventional time-frequency representation can be moderated using M-estimation of robust statistics. Instead of treating the transient components as impulsive noise and removing them, the proposed RALP TF distribution yields separately a time domain representation of the transient components and a conventional TF representation of the sinusoidal components, which greatly improves the visualization and detection of these components. Simulation results show that the proposed RALP differentiates the two kinds of components well, and offers better time and frequency resolutions than the conventional Lomb periodogram.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种稳健的自适应 Lomb 周期图 (RALP)，用于对具有正弦和瞬态分量（可能是非均匀采样）的时间序列进行时频 (TF) 分析。它通过对观测数据加窗来扩展传统的 Lomb 谱，并通过置信区间交集 (ICI) 规则自适应地选择窗口长度。瞬态分量对传统时频表示的影响可以使用鲁棒统计的 M 估计来调节。所提出的 RALP TF 分布不是将瞬态分量视为脉冲噪声并去除它们，而是分别产生瞬态分量的时域表示和传统的 TF 表示。

title: Robust local polynomial regression using M-estimator with adaptive bandwidth
title_en: Robust local polynomial regression using M-estimator with adaptive bandwidth
title_zh: 使用具有自适应带宽的 M 估计器的鲁棒局部多项式回归
abstract_en: In this paper, a new method for robust local polynomial regression (LPR) using M-estimator with adaptive bandwidth is proposed. This is motivated by the limitation of traditional LPR in detecting and removing impulsive noise or outlies. By using M-estimation technique and the intersection of confidence intervals (ICI) rule for choosing an adaptive local bandwidth, a robust LPR algorithm is developed. Simulation results show that the new M-estimation-based LPR performs considerably better than the traditional LS-based method in removing the impulsive noise as well as preserving the jump discontinuities, which are frequently found in image and video processing.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，提出了一种使用具有自适应带宽的 M 估计器的鲁棒局部多项式回归（LPR）的新方法。这是由于传统 LPR 在检测和消除脉冲噪声或异常值方面的局限性。通过使用 M 估计技术和置信区间交集 (ICI) 规则来选择自适应局部带宽，开发了鲁棒的 LPR 算法。仿真结果表明，新的基于 M 估计的 LPR 在消除脉冲噪声以及保留图像和视频处理中常见的跳跃不连续性方面比传统的基于 LS 的方法表现得更好。

title: Multi-resolution analysis of non-uniform data with jump discontinuities and impulsive noise using robust local polynomial regression
title_en: Multi-resolution analysis of non-uniform data with jump discontinuities and impulsive noise using robust local polynomial regression
title_zh: 使用稳健的局部多项式回归对具有跳跃不连续性和脉冲噪声的非均匀数据进行多分辨率分析
abstract_en: The paper proposes a new method for performing multi-resolution analysis (MRA) of non-uniform data with jump discontinuities and impulsive noise using robust M-estimator-based local polynomial regression (LPR). The basic idea is to interpolate the smoothed estimate, after performing the robust LPR, on a uniform grid in order to perform the MRA using the ordinary wavelet transform. Simulation results show that the new approach performs better than traditional LS-based LPR in preserving jump discontinuities and suppressing isolated impulses when intersection confident intervals (ICI) bandwidth selection is employed.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新方法，使用基于鲁棒 M 估计器的局部多项式回归 (LPR) 对具有跳跃不连续性和脉冲噪声的非均匀数据进行多分辨率分析 (MRA)。基本思想是在执行鲁棒 LPR 后，在均匀网格上插值平滑估计，以便使用普通小波变换执行 MRA。仿真结果表明，当采用相交置信区间 (ICI) 带宽选择时，新方法在保留跳跃不连续性和抑制孤立脉冲方面比传统的基于 LS 的 LPR 表现更好。
